description: Supports applications for city burial financial assistance and the Social Case Study Report or endorsement required by partner institutions.
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor / City Social Welfare and Development Office
whoMayAvail: Indigent residents of the City of Meycauayan and qualified people's organizations
steps: Answer the questions during the intake interview.
Wait while the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter are prepared.
Receive the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter.
requirements: Original Barangay Certificate of Indigency or Residency
Valid government-issued ID of the client or beneficiary (photocopy; three specimen signatures where required)
Referral letter (original), if referred by another office or organization
Funeral Contract (original and 1 photocopy)
Death Certificate (original and 1 photocopy)
Valid ID of the representative (original and 1 photocopy)
Promissory note or certification from the funeral service indicating the outstanding balance (original and 1 photocopy)

detailedRequirements.requirement: Barangay Certificate of Indigency (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Barangay Hall

detailedRequirements.requirement: Funeral Contract (original and 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Current funeral service provider

detailedRequirements.requirement: Death Certificate (original and 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Hall, City Civil Registry Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Valid ID of the representative (original and 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Government agencies and COMELEC that issue IDs

detailedRequirements.requirement: Promissory note or certification indicating the outstanding balance (original and 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Current funeral service provider

clientSteps.action: Submit the complete requirements for receipt and review.
Answer the questions during the intake interview.
Wait while the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter are prepared.
Receive the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter.

processingTime: 40 minutes for the Social Case Study Report; financial-assistance processing is subject to assessment and approval
personResponsible: City Social Welfare and Development Office

description: Issues an identification card that enables qualified senior citizens to access the benefits and privileges provided under Republic Act No. 9994, including applicable discounts and VAT exemptions.
officeDivision: City Social Welfare and Development Office
whoMayAvail: Residents of the City of Meycauayan who are 60 years old or older
steps: Submit the completed application form and complete requirements.
Wait for the scheduled release while the Senior Citizen ID is prepared.
requirements: Accomplished Senior Citizen ID application form (original)
Barangay Clearance (original and 1 photocopy)
One latest 1 x 1 photograph
Voter's ID or Voter's Affidavit (1 photocopy)
Birth Certificate or SSS ID for applicants aged 60 to 65 (1 photocopy)

detailedRequirements.requirement: Accomplished Senior Citizen ID application form (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Office for Senior Citizens Affairs / City Social Welfare and Development Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Barangay Clearance (original and 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Barangay Hall of the applicant's current residence

detailedRequirements.requirement: One latest 1 x 1 photograph
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: To be provided by the applicant

detailedRequirements.requirement: Voter's ID or Voter's Affidavit (1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: COMELEC

detailedRequirements.requirement: Birth Certificate or SSS ID for applicants aged 60 to 65 (1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Local Civil Registrar Office or SSS

Wait for the scheduled release while the Senior Citizen ID is prepared.

description: Issues an identification card that enables qualified solo parents to access benefits and privileges provided under the Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000, or Republic Act No. 8972.
officeDivision: City Social Welfare and Development Office
whoMayAvail: Residents of the City of Meycauayan who qualify as solo parents
steps: Submit the completed application form and complete requirements.
Wait for the scheduled release while the Solo Parent ID is prepared.
requirements: Accomplished Solo Parent application form (original)
Valid government-issued ID (photocopy)
Barangay Certificate of solo-parent status and residency (original)
Two recent 2 x 2 ID photographs (original)
Birth Certificate of the applicant (photocopy)
Birth Certificates of dependent children (photocopies)

Documentary proof of the qualifying circumstance under Republic Act No. 11861, such as a spouse's death certificate, detention certificate, medical certificate, overseas-employment record, court order, or affidavit, as applicable

detailedRequirements.requirement: Accomplished Solo Parent application form (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Social Welfare and Development Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Valid government-issued ID (photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Government issuing agency

detailedRequirements.requirement: Barangay Certificate of solo-parent status and residency (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Barangay Hall of the applicant's current residence

detailedRequirements.requirement: Two recent 2 x 2 ID photographs (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: To be provided by the applicant

detailedRequirements.requirement: Birth Certificate of the applicant and Birth Certificates of dependent children (photocopies)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Local Civil Registrar Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Documentary proof of the qualifying circumstance under Republic Act No. 11861, as applicable
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Civil registrar, court, medical facility, employer, detention facility, or other issuing office, depending on the applicant's circumstance

clientSteps.action: Submit the completed application form and complete requirements for receipt and review.
Wait for the scheduled release while the Solo Parent ID is prepared.

personResponsible: City Social Welfare and Development Officer
City Social Welfare and Development Office

description: Issues an identification card that serves as proof of eligibility for benefits and privileges provided to persons with disabilities under Republic Act No. 10754.
officeDivision: City Social Welfare and Development Office
whoMayAvail: Residents of the City of Meycauayan who are persons with disabilities
steps: Submit the completed application form and complete requirements.
Wait for the scheduled release while the PWD ID is prepared.
requirements: Accomplished PWD application form (original)
Barangay Clearance, Certificate of Indigency, or Certificate of Residency (original)
Medical Certificate or Clinical Abstract stating the disability (original), required for non-apparent disabilities and issued within the prescribed validity period
Two recent 2 x 2 ID photographs (original; taken within the last 6 months)
Recent colored whole-body photograph (original), for an apparent disability
School assessment (original), for an enrolled special-education student when applicable
Authorization letter (original) and representative's valid ID, if filed by a representative
Notarized Affidavit of Loss (original), for replacement of a lost ID

detailedRequirements.requirement: Accomplished PWD application form (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Social Welfare and Development Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Barangay Clearance, Certificate of Indigency, or Certificate of Residency (original)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Barangay Hall of the applicant's current residence

detailedRequirements.requirement: Medical Certificate or Clinical Abstract stating the disability (original), for a non-apparent disability
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Health Office or a hospital specializing in the applicable PWD diagnosis

detailedRequirements.requirement: Two recent 2 x 2 ID photographs and, when applicable, a recent colored whole-body photograph
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: To be provided by the applicant

detailedRequirements.requirement: School assessment (original), for an enrolled special-education student when applicable
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: School or special-education program

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization letter and representative's valid ID, if filed by a representative
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Applicant and government issuing agency

detailedRequirements.requirement: Notarized Affidavit of Loss (original), for replacement of a lost ID
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Notary public

clientSteps.action: Submit the completed application form and complete requirements for receipt and review.
Wait for the scheduled release while the PWD ID is prepared.

personResponsible: City Social Welfare and Development Officer
City Social Welfare and Development Office
